referenceSql:
DELIMITER $$
CREATE PROCEDURE dept_course_avg()
BEGIN
  SELECT s.Sdept AS sdept,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.Cname='数据结构' THEN x.Grade END),2) AS `数据结构`,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.Cname='数据库原理' THEN x.Grade END),2) AS `数据库原理`,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.Cname='操作系统' THEN x.Grade END),2) AS `操作系统`
  FROM student s JOIN sc x USING(Sno) JOIN course c USING(Cno)
  WHERE c.Cname IN ('数据结构','数据库原理','操作系统')
  GROUP BY s.Sdept;
END$$
DELIMITER ;
